result:
I changed no files. The project has no UI layer (no `.tsx`, no components, no framework), so the "screen" part has no existing pattern to reuse. Each kind of work the task needs maps to this:

| Work needed | Existing code | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Fetch a JSON list from the API | `src/features/orders/index.ts:6-8` (`listOrders`) | Calls `request<Order[]>('/orders')`. The reports version is `request<Report[]>('/reports')`, same shape. |
| Shared HTTP call, auth, retries | `src/api/client.ts:3-10` (`request`) | Prepends `/api`, adds the Bearer token from localStorage, retries 5xx up to 3 times, and throws on other errors. Use it, don't call `fetch` directly. |
| Show a cent amount as a price | `the price helper:3-5` (`formatPrice`) | Divides by 100 and formats as USD. Use it for each `totalCents`. |
| Build a display string from an entry | `src/features/orders/index.ts:14-16` (`orderLabel`) and `src/features/cart/index.ts:33-36` (`cartSummary`) | Shows the pattern of combining a label with `formatPrice`. Useful if the screen renders text rows. |
| Export types for a feature's data | `src/features/orders/index.ts:4` (`Order`), `src/features/cart/index.ts:4-5` | Add `export type Report = { month: string; totalCents: number }` in the same style. |
| Feature entry point | `src/features/cart/index.ts`, `src/features/orders/index.ts` | Both are a single `index.ts` per feature, so `src/features/reports/index.ts` fits. |

Gaps with no existing code:
- **Month formatting.** Nothing in the repo handles dates. `month` will likely need a small helper, or it can be shown as-is.
- **Rendering a screen.** Nothing renders rows or lists in a UI. The closest is the text-based `cartSummary`.
- **Tests.** No test files or test runner exist (`package.json` has only `typescript` as a dev dependency).
